chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Qulawayh and al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Bundar together, from Sa’d, from al-Yaqtini, from Yunus b. Abd al-Rahman … he said: Hisham b. al-Hakam narrated to me that he heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:

Do not accept a narration on our authority except that which is in agreement with the Qur’an and the Sunna or you find for it a corroboration from our past narrations … so fear Allah and do not accept on our authority that which opposes the Word of our Lord the Exalted and the Sunna of our prophet (peace be upon him and his family) … so do not accept on our authority what opposes the Qur’an, for when we narrate we only do narrate what is in agreement with the Qur’an and in agreement with the Sunna …
ai.seo_question: How to verify if a hadith is authentic according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal* highlights the Imami principle of *al-muwafaqa* (concordance), where the Qur’an and Sunna serve as the primary criteria for validating prophetic and imamic traditions. It underscores the scholarly practice of cross-referencing narrations to ensure they do not contradict divine revelation, reinforcing the Imams' role as faithful interpreters of the Quran. This criterion remains central to Shia hadith sciences for distinguishing authentic reports from fabricated ones.

en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/92] Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Qulawayh and al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Bundar together from Sa’d from al-Yaqtini from Yunus b. Abd al-Rahman … he said: Hisham b. al-Hakam narrated to me that he heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying:

do not accept a narration on our authority except that which is in agreement with the Qur’an and the Sunna or you find for it a corroboration from our past narrations … so fear Allah and do not accept on our authority that which opposes the Word of our Lord the Exalted and the Sunna of our prophet صلى الله عليه وآله … so do not accept on our authority what opposes the Qur’an, for when we narrate we only do narrate what is in agreement with the Qur’an and in agreement with the Sunna …
